steps.summary: Signed in with bench@example.com, then created ticket 'fwrd39-n2 RD Bench Ticket'. Required fields were: **Title** (the ticket name) and **Customer** (set to "Bench Test Co"). After submitting, the ticket was created and is visible in the detail view at RD-1016 with status "Draft", customer "Bench Test Co", and raised date 2026-09-01. Confirmation text: the heading reads "fwrd39-n2 RD Bench Ticket" and the breadcrumb/ref shows RD-1016 — confirming the ticket exists.

On ticket RD-1016 'fwrd39-n2 RD Bench Ticket', added part 'fwrd39-n2 RD Part A' with cost $100.00 and 25% markup. The computed price shown on the page for this part is **$125.00** (cost + 25% markup × qty 1). The parts table lists: Name=fwrd39-n2 RD Part A, Cost=$100.00, Markup=25%, Qty=1, Supplier=No supplier, Price=$125.00. Total (price × quantity) = $125.00. The required fields in the Add part form were: Part name (text), Cost (number), and Markup % (number); Quantity defaults to 1 and Supplier is optional.

Added second part "fwrd39-n2 RD Part B" with Cost=$200 and Markup=25% (Quantity=1, No supplier). After submission the detail view refreshed with both parts listed: Part A ($100.00 cost, 25% markup, $125.00 price) and Part B ($200.00 cost, 25% markup, $250.00 price). The total shown is $375.00 ($125 + $250). The app computes Part B's price as **$250.00**.

Edited part "fwrd39-n2 RD Part A" in ticket RD-1016: changed Cost from $100 to $150 while keeping Markup at 25%. The detail view refreshed immediately. Part A now shows Cost=$150.00, Markup=25%, Price=$187.50 (was $125.00). The new parts total is **$437.50** (Part A $187.50 + Part B $250.00).

Clicked "Mark Ready" on ticket RD-1016. The app showed an alert: "Ticket is not ready - Part 'fwrd39-n2 RD Part A' has no supplier - Part 'fwrd39-n2 RD Part B' has no supplier". The precondition was: **every part must have a Supplier assigned**. I edited each part (Part A and Part B) and set their Supplier field to "Bench Supplier Co". After saving both, I clicked "Mark Ready" again and the status changed from "Draft" to "Ready". The buttons changed to "Mark Draft" and "Mark Closed", confirming the new status. The final status is **Ready**.

Deleted both parts and archived the ticket. For each part, clicked the delete button which triggered a custom "Confirm" dialog with "Cancel" and "Delete part" buttons — accepted the confirmation by clicking "Delete part". Part A and Part B both disappeared from the parts table (showing "No parts on this ticket yet"). Then clicked "Archive ticket" (no dialog appeared; the button changed to "Unarchive ticket"). Went to the tickets list — RD-1016 is absent from the active list. Clicked "Show archived" and found it listed: title "fwrd39-n2 RD Bench Ticket Archived", status Ready, Parts 0. Everything is cleaned up.
